columns.categoria: Service category name. Created automatically in the tenant if it doesn't exist yet.

products.categoria: Product category name. Created automatically in the tenant (as a product category) if it doesn't exist yet.
products.impuesto: Tax name to associate with the product. Leave empty to create the product with no tax.

services.categoria: Cannot be empty. If it already exists in the tenant as a product category, the row is rejected.
services.nombre: Cannot be empty. Must not repeat another row of the file with the same categoria (not case-sensitive): only the first one is imported.
services.precio: Cannot be empty. Must be a whole number (dots as thousands separators are accepted, e.g. 150.000). Cannot be negative; 0 is allowed.
services.duracion_minutos: Cannot be empty. Must be a whole number of at least 1 (e.g. 45).
services.impuesto: If filled in, it must match the name of a tax that already exists in the tenant (not case-sensitive, e.g. IVA 10%).
services.activo: No validation: only NO creates the record as inactive; any other value (or empty) creates it as active.

products.categoria: Cannot be empty. If it already exists in the tenant as a service category, the row is rejected.
products.nombre: Cannot be empty. Must not repeat another row of the file with the same categoria (not case-sensitive): only the first one is imported.
products.precio: Cannot be empty. Must be a whole number (dots as thousands separators are accepted, e.g. 95.000). Cannot be negative; 0 is allowed.
products.impuesto: If filled in, it must match the name of a tax that already exists in the tenant (not case-sensitive, e.g. IVA 10%).
products.activo: No validation: only NO creates the record as inactive; any other value (or empty) creates it as active.
products.sku: If filled in, up to 64 characters (e.g. SH-300).

clients.telefono: If filled in, it must not match (comparing digits only) the phone of an existing client of the tenant or of an earlier row of the file.
clients.email: No validation. Several clients may share the same email.
clients.ruc: If filled in, it must have the format digits-hyphen-check digit (e.g. 80000005-6) and must not repeat the RUC of an existing client of the tenant or of an earlier row of the file.
clients.activo: No validation: only NO creates the record as inactive; any other value (or empty) creates it as active.

professionals.telefono: If filled in, it must have 10 digits: 4-digit area code + 6-digit number (spaces, parentheses and hyphens are ignored, e.g. 0981 123456).
professionals.email: If filled in, it must be a valid email (e.g. ana@salon.com) and must not repeat (not case-sensitive) the email of an existing professional of the tenant or of an earlier row of the file.
professionals.activo: No validation: only NO creates the record as inactive; any other value (or empty) creates it as active.

dashboard.heading: Tenant workspace
dashboard.lead: Open a section to manage this tenant.
dashboard.contractorsDesc: Link users by email, remove, or inactivate within this tenant.
dashboard.catalogDesc: Categories, services, client price, and contractor cost (fixed or % of client price).
dashboard.assignmentsDesc: Choose which services each contractor may provide (replace-on-save).
dashboard.planningDesc: Draft availability by day and time, publish a month, copy to the next month.

contractors.heading: Contractors
contractors.lead: Contractors must already have a platform account. Search by email, then add them to this tenant.
contractors.emailPlaceholder: Type part of the user email
contractors.searchMinChars: Enter at least two characters to search.
contractors.noUserHint: No matching users. The person must register before they can be added as a contractor.
contractors.removeConfirmDescription: Their service assignments and planning rows for this tenant are removed. Their platform account is unchanged.

errors.USER_MUST_REGISTER_FIRST: That user is not registered yet.
errors.CONTRACTOR_ALREADY_LINKED: This user is already a contractor for this tenant.

catalog.heading: Service catalog
catalog.lead: Create categories, then services with client price and contractor cost.
catalog.needCategoryFirst: Create at least one category before adding services.

errors.DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME: A category with this name already exists.
errors.DUPLICATE_SERVICE_NAME: A service with this name already exists.
errors.INVALID_CLIENT_PRICE: Client price must be zero or greater.

assignments.heading: Contractor service assignments
assignments.lead: Saving replaces the full set of allowed services for the selected contractor (add and remove in one action).
assignments.replaceHint: Check the services this contractor may provide, then save. Unchecked services are removed from their assignment.
assignments.savedReplaceHint: Assignments saved. The list you saved now defines which services this contractor may provide.

planning.heading: Planning
planning.lead: Draft planning until you publish the month. Published months are read-only here; copy the prior month into the next as draft to adjust.
planning.copiedTo: Copied to {{target}}. Omitted {{omitted}} row(s) for missing or inactive contractors.
planning.readOnlyHint: This month is published. Draft changes are blocked; copy to the next month to build a new draft.
planning.monthViewHint: Showing all assignments in the selected calendar month.
